Title: Name changes and GUID migration: Azure App Service on Linux Standard plan

Body.Content:
With Azure App Service, you can quickly build, deploy, and scale enterprise-grade web, mobile, and API apps running on any platform.

To help App Service customers better understand their App Service resource consumption by operating platform, the new App Service on Linux Standard plan (along with the Basic and Premium plans) is now generally available. New names and resource GUIDs will be reflected in billing statements starting June 1, 2018. There won’t be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on names or resource GUIDs.

  • Learn more about the Basic plan name changes and GUID migration on the Basic plan GUID migration and name change webpage.
  • Learn more about the Premium plan name changes and GUID migration on the Premium plan GUID migration and name change webpage.

See the tables below for the Standard plan GUID migration details and new names.

With Azure App Service, you can quickly build, deploy, and scale enterprise-grade web, mobile, and API apps running on any platform.

To help App Service customers better understand their App Service resource consumption by operating platform, the new App Service on Linux Standard plan (along with the Basic and Premium plans) is now generally available. New names and resource GUIDs will be reflected in billing statements starting June 1, 2018. There won’t be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on names or resource GUIDs.

Learn more about the Basic plan name changes and GUID migration on the Basic plan GUID migration and name change webpage .

Learn more about the Premium plan name changes and GUID migration on the Premium plan GUID migration and name change webpage .

See the tables below for the Standard plan GUID migration details and new names.
